title: Master bill of materials - Porsche 993 Turbo M64/60 3.6 L twin-turbo engine
purpose: Authoritative part list for all later geometry and simulation packages. Every part carries an evidence status per field class, an exact local source citation, the current fidelity level (repo ladder in twins/m64-engine-system/program.json), the existing twin/geometry reference if any, and a redesign-interest flag.
status: research registry - no part here is dimensionally accurate, fitted, tested, safe or released

evidence_status_legend.measured: dimension or spec obtained by physical metrology on a project part (none exist engine-wide yet; torque specs from the official workshop manual are classed measured_source below)
evidence_status_legend.sourced: value carried by a citable local source record or official manual registry entry; declared by the source, not measured by this project
evidence_status_legend.assumed: engineering inference recorded as assumption; promotes nothing
evidence_status_legend.missing: no local evidence; field is null

field_class_conventions: identity = part number + fitment identity; dims = primary dimensions/geometry; interfaces = mounting/mating interfaces; loads = operating/assembly loads and torques. 'measured_source' is used only for official 993 Repair Manual torque values registered in catalog/manual/993-workshop-manual-measurements.json: they are factory-specified, not project-measured, and never promote fidelity.
fidelity_note: All verified fidelity is F0_reference: per program.json cross_zone_rules no zone exceeds F1_envelope until a common engine metrology frame exists.

known_conflicts: Dry engine mass: 232 kg (brochure, research doc) vs 268 kg (elferclassic.de, catalog/sources/src-elferclassic-993-turbo-technical-data.json). Unresolved; value left null at assembly level.
Cooling airflow: 1010 l/s @ ~6100 rpm (primary, OBD supplement) vs 1210 l/s @ 5750 rpm (elferclassic, demoted SINGLE_SOURCE).
Compression ratio: 9.5:1 (brochure via research doc) vs 8.0:1 (elferclassic record). Unresolved; neither used for geometry.
pet_reference_gaps: PET group 107-20 (Turbocharging, 65 lines / 38 references) and 107-45 hold the official exhaust-manifold and turbo-plumbing part numbers but were only audited at group level (docs/PORSCHEFANATICS_993_TURBO_AUDIT.md); per-line transcription is the cheapest way to close identity gaps for exhaust_manifolds and charge_air.
